attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"It is a fascinating way to spend a quadrum, provided one enjoys the scenery of a stalemate.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies a stalemate and a quadrum-long duration of the war, which the briefing does not give"},{"span":"As I reported last time, the Embertail Tribe is at war with the Gray Wharf Syndicate.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as a full second item rather than a short clause, though it is marked as old"}],"voice":4,"clarity":4,"tone":4,"overall":3,"comment":"The Malley item is accurate and dry, but the second item pads the bulletin with old news and a stalemate the briefing never mentions.
